input_schema: EventV1: UInt64 key, Int64 value_i64, Int64 event_time_ms
global_frontier: all-assigned-partitions min, or unknown; never exclude idle partitions
hash: v1: BLAKE3(u64 little-endian), low five bits
checkpoint: full local immutable generation, matched quiescent state/confirmed offsets/time; file and directory sync; atomic CURRENT replacement
restore: explicit --restore; all bytes/ownership/progress and semantic fingerprint validated; Kafka ranges/config/identity verified before output; new session UUID
source_contract: one trusted immutable Kafka topic/cluster, 1..4 explicit partitions, uncompressed <=32768-byte batch history; no group offset commits
supported: signed Euclidean tumbling windows, checked Int64 sum/UInt64 count
real hot/cold eviction and repeated read-through updates
sink-confirmed receipt and window output cuts
manual checkpoint restore with retained Kafka offsets and logical time
1->2->4->1 separate local owner stores on restore
cancellation, disk quota/partial/corrupt I/O refusals, integrity and identity refusals
owned control-only polling during synchronous state/checkpoint I/O
refused_or_deferred: automatic recovery, Kafka groups/rebalances or offset resets
reopening/retractions, sliding/session windows, general SQL/state APIs
live physical membership, cross-host state migration or distributed rescale
remote checkpoints, replication, HA or disk-loss durability
expired/missing source offsets, corrupt/unsupported/duplicate/unsafe checkpoint data
nonempty working root until operator proves the old attempt dead and removes orphans
unverified topic incarnation/history, compressed or oversized historical batches
cross_partition_order: Kafka has no total merge order; window/late results are deterministic for the observed delivery trace. Stable IDs do not attest payload equality under different legal late-data interleavings.
